forWhat: The new Assessments screens: make an assessment, read one that came back, and follow each one through its steps to results in.
Each assessment is one row, or one card on the board. Its button is always the next thing to do.

layout.shows: Answers for you to judge, packs to approve and papers to sign off, and assessments with every paper confirmed. Each tile opens the first one it counts.
Four buttons: [[For a class]], [[For each child]], [[For one child]] and [[A ready-made worksheet]].
A box to drop scans or photos, and a field for a Google Drive link with the button [[Read it]].
Class, Topic, Subject, Kind, Week and Stage, and a search box.
The same assessments, as a board or as a table. The board has one lane for who has the paper; the table has a row for each, with the step it waits at.
The steps from [[Created]] to [[Results in]], the pack, and each child's copy as its own row.
The page as photographed beside each answer, marked right, wrong, wrong with working, blank, or for you to judge.

jobs.title: Make an assessment for a class
steps: Press [[Make an assessment]], or the button [[For a class]].
Choose the class, what it is, how it is made, and the children.
Press [[See the papers]]. Every child's paper shows on screen before anything is made.
Not happy with a child's questions? Press [[Different questions]]. It draws others and makes nothing.
Press [[Make and approve …]]. The papers are made exactly as you saw them, in your name.

jobs.title: Approve a pack
steps: Open the assessment from its row or its card.
Press [[Approve the pack]]. It approves this pack only, in your name.
Then press [[Print]]. The pack opens in a new tab.

jobs.title: Change one child's level before print
steps: Open the assessment. Before the pack is approved each copy shows its level as a choice.
Choose the new level for that child. It is kept as your change, with your name.
Once the pack is approved the choice goes.

jobs.title: Check a child's paper
steps: Press [[Check this paper]] on the child's row.
Look at the answer in focus. Type what the child wrote and press [[Say what the child wrote]].
If the child wrote nothing, press [[Blank (the child wrote nothing)]]. Blank is never marked wrong.
When nothing is left to judge, press [[Sign this paper off]].

jobs.title: Sign a paper off
steps: On the assessment, press [[Sign it off]] on one child's row. It signs that paper only.

buttons.label: Make an assessment
buttons.does: Opens the choice of four ways to make one.

buttons.label: Different questions
buttons.does: Draws other questions for you to look at.

buttons.label: Make and approve …
buttons.does: Makes the papers you saw and approves them in your name.
buttons.doesNot: If you change a choice, it waits until you see the papers again. Pressing it twice makes the papers once.

buttons.label: Read it
buttons.does: Reads the scan at a Google Drive link.
buttons.doesNot: It takes only Google Drive links.

buttons.label: Approve the pack
buttons.does: Approves this pack, in your name.

buttons.label: Sign it off
buttons.does: Confirms one paper's results in your name.
buttons.doesNot: No other paper is signed off.

buttons.label: Say what the child wrote
buttons.does: Records what you read on the child's page as a new line beside the engine's read. The engine marks it.
buttons.doesNot: The engine's own read is never changed.

buttons.label: Sign this paper off
buttons.does: Confirms this paper's results. It shows only when nothing is left to judge.
